DOOM Revitalized 1.3 weapon assets
==================================

Source supplied by the user: DOOM_Revitalized_1.3.pk3

Adapted assets:
- Knife first-person and pickup sprites
- Silenced-pistol first-person and pickup sprites
- Knife swing/impact and silenced-pistol sounds

TuinRPG supplies new ZScript weapon behavior, Rogue-only pickup rules,
multiplayer ownership checks, RPG item-level integration, critical-hit rules,
and bleed integration. The supplied archive contains no standalone license or
credits document, so this record preserves the exact immediate source.
